name: Kusunoki Yao
source:
Yao is the protagonist’s petite classmate, and she’s the only person in the art club, even though the school is very large. She doesn’t speak very much, tends to show little emotion and can appear cold, but she’s actually just not very good at talking to people. Even though she does all of this, the protagonist still finds her quite interesting. She has a complex over her height and tries different methods to try to grow more. She also loves animals.

[Edited and taken from [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/09/20/previewstrawberry-nauts/]Liemyx's preview[/url]]
